name: 泰拉记事社（官方漫画）
description: 鹰角网络官方公开漫画，涵盖泰拉与塔卫二两个主题。每次打开章节重新请求全部分页的签名图片地址；图片链接过期后请重新打开章节，当前宿主不支持图片 HTTP 403 自动刷新。

attribution.implementation: Independent JavaScript implementation of the official public JSON protocol; no upstream code copied. Separate topic feeds and topic-qualified identities, ascending chapter reading order, bounded four-worker image resolution and explicit access errors. Does not port Android image-403 refresh interceptor.
attribution.bounds: No login/payment/access-control bypass; official HTTPS image hosts only. At most two catalog requests per search, 2000 chapters per detail and 1000 images per chapter. Signed URLs are refreshed on a new content call, not on individual image HTTP 403.
